steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest Part A (4 min)
steps.instructions: Fill each gap with one phrase from the box, in the correct form. Use each phrase once. Box: stand at · fluctuate · overtake · surge · account for · soar · plummet · level off

items.label: 1. Online sales ______ from 5 to 30 million in two years.
2. Print sales ______ to just 2 million after 2015.
3. The figure ______ at 60 and did not rise again.
4. Last year, women ______ 40% of all students.
6. Prices ______ between 20 and 30 dollars all year.
7. House prices ______ in 2021, reaching a record high.
8. In 2015, online news ______ television as the main source.

steps.title: Step 3 · Group the data and write Body 1 (9 min)
steps.instructions: Look at the table: hours per week that teenagers spent on four apps. (a) Group the four apps into two groups by trend (2 min). (b) Write Body 1 for the group that rose the most (7 min). Use a topic sentence, start, change, end and one comparison. Use at least 2 phrases from Step 1. Support: Body 1: TikTok and YouTube ______. TikTok started at ______ in 2013, ______ to ______ in 2016, and ______ to ______ in 2022.

images.alt: Table: hours per week teenagers spent on Facebook, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, 2013 to 2022

open.q: (a) Two groups and the trend of each group
open.model: Group 1: TikTok and YouTube (rose). Group 2: Facebook (fell) and Instagram (rose slightly, then stayed stable). Another grouping is fine if the reason is clear.

open.q: (b) Body 1 for the group that rose the most
open.model: TikTok and YouTube were the two apps that rose. TikTok started at zero hours in 2013, rose to 1 hour in 2016, and then surged to 10 hours in 2022. YouTube showed a steadier increase, climbing from 4 hours to 9 hours over the same period, so it was overtaken by TikTok in the final year.

ai.type: Body 1 cho Task 1 table (nhóm số liệu)
ai.task: The table shows hours per week that teenagers spent on four apps (Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) in 2013, 2016, 2019 and 2022. Write Body 1 for the group of apps that rose the most (TikTok: 0, 1, 5, 10; YouTube: 4, 5, 7, 9).
